_comment: VISUAL CANON — Sir Roderic Lightbearer (PC). Identity only; rendering is handled by the global house-style block (config/image/prompts/house-style.json). Inject this entity's `appearance` (and `critical_clauses`/`do_not_drift`) into any scene spec featuring Roderic. Derived in the character-consistency spike (M2 judged pass at R4) by DE-GLOSSING the player refs and applying two human overrides; held in the M3 two-subject and M5 composite seeds. Canon format is structured JSON (locked in M1).
name: Sir Roderic Lightbearer
status_note: VALIDATED 2026-05-31 (refinement session). The earlier de-gloss over-corrected to dull matte battle-worn steel; per user calibration the de-gloss was PARTIALLY REVERSED — Roderic's plate is now PRISTINE, ORNATE (heavy gold filigree matching the player refs) and REALISTICALLY POLISHED (soft satin sheen, NOT the refs' artificial CGI/chrome sheen), full plate down to greaves + steel sabatons, with the cloth tabard/arming-skirt dropped. Locked by the FRONT (round r4) and SIDE (round r2) library images — each judge pass + own-eyes gate + user accept. See house_style_exception and library_recipe. The separate front/side spec files were consolidated into this single canon file (user 2026-05-31).
source_image: config/image/library/sir-roderic-lightbearer-front.jpg and sir-roderic-lightbearer-side.jpg (the VALIDATED full-length front + side references) — use THESE as the identity + armor source
source_note: images/pcs/roderic-pose.jpg and images/pcs/roderic-horse.jpg — the player refs — are now the ARMOR-ORNATENESS source: keep their FACE, their gold-lion-on-blue heraldry, and the DENSITY of their ornate gold filigree/inlay. Do NOT copy their artificial CGI/chrome sheen (use a realistic satin polish instead), their white cloth surcoat/tabard, or any cloth arming-skirt between the legs — those are dropped.
derived_from: player refs (face + lion heraldry + ornate-gold density) → realistically-polished + greaves/sabatons + no-cloth-skirt overrides; validated by the front library image (refinement session 2026-05-31), building on spike M2/M3/M5
human_overrides: CLEAN-SHAVEN: both player refs read clean-shaven; the model strongly wants to beard this weathered knight. Roderic has NO facial hair at all — no beard, moustache, goatee, sideburns, or stubble. (Supersedes any ref.)

NO TABARD/SURCOAT/CLOTH-SKIRT: the player ref shows a white cloth tabard with the cross and a cloth skirt between the legs; canon is BARE ORNATE FULL PLATE with the Light-cross inlaid into the steel breastplate — no cloth garment over the torso, and no cloth arming-skirt/surcoat-skirt between the legs (only the cloak drapes behind). (Supersedes the ref; user confirmed 2026-05-31.)

PRISTINE ORNATE POLISHED PLATE: the plate is immaculate and richly decorated with dense gold filigree (matching the refs' ornateness) and REALISTICALLY polished to a soft satin sheen — NOT dull/matte/dented/rusted, and NOT artificial CGI/chrome mirror-gloss. (Partially reverses the earlier de-gloss; user calibrated 2026-05-31.)
ARMORED FEET: full plate runs all the way down — articulated greaves over the shins and ARTICULATED STEEL SABATONS on the feet (overlapping metal lames + steel toe-cap), never leather or cloth boots.
house_style_exception: Roderic KNOWINGLY OVERRIDES the global house-style metal rules (config/image/house-style.json), analogous to how aurelion.json documents the Chryseum as the sacred-building gloss exception. The global style forbids 'glossy mirror-polish or pristine gleaming armor/metal' and 'clean matching equipment with no wear' and pins 'dull matte steel' + 'tarnished amber-gold, never bright'. For Roderic ONLY: ALLOW realistic polished steel with a soft satin/brushed sheen under diffuse overcast light, and rich ornate gold filigree/inlay (warm/luminous, not neon). STILL FORBID the artificial look — chrome/CGI mirror-gloss, glassy plastic sheen, blown-out specular highlights, epic-hero rim-lighting, bright saturated skies, heroic posing. medium/lighting/tone are UNCHANGED so Roderic still renders in the same painterly-photoreal documentary house style as the rest of the library. The defining line: realistic polish (a well-kept museum-grade harness under soft cloud light) — NOT artificial CGI sheen.

library_images.front: config/image/library/sir-roderic-lightbearer-front.jpg (validated full-length FRONT reference) — the canonical identity-truth picture; seed future Roderic illustrations from this
library_images.side: config/image/library/sir-roderic-lightbearer-side.jpg (validated full-length SIDE/PROFILE reference, consistent with the front)

library_recipe._note: Self-contained recipe to regenerate the front/side library turnaround images from THIS file alone (the separate front/side spec files were consolidated away). Assemble a one-shot spec = house_style_override (below) + this `appearance` + critical_clauses.eye_lighting + the per-view composition + a do_not_include built from do_not_drift plus the common turnaround forbids. Generate with: python3 scripts/generate-image.py --prompt-file <assembled spec> --name <slug> --out-dir image/spike --tall (1024x1536). Judge each candidate with a fresh adversarial subagent (the image stays in the subagent; only the verdict returns), then an own-eyes gate, then the user. The SIDE view judges for CONSISTENCY against the committed FRONT library image — NOT the player refs.
library_recipe.house_style_override: Use config/image/house-style.json VERBATIM except, per house_style_exception: in `palette` swap 'dull matte steel and old iron' -> 'bright polished steel with a soft realistic sheen' and add 'rich ornate gold filigree and inlay (warm and luminous, not neon)'; in `avoid` DROP 'glossy mirror-polish or pristine gleaming armor/metal' and 'clean matching equipment with no wear' and ADD 'artificial chrome/CGI mirror-gloss, glassy plastic sheen, or blown-out specular highlights on metal'. Keep medium/lighting/tone unchanged.
library_recipe.composition_front: Tall full-length FRONT portrait: entire figure head-to-sabatons, the whole body and both armored feet in frame with headroom above and floor below. Plain neutral mid-grey studio backdrop, turnaround-reference style, no scenery. Candid settled stance, weight on one hip, hands loose and asymmetric; the LEFT arm carries the heater shield with its face toward the viewer (rampant gold lion on deep-blue). Soft even frontal fill so the pale-blue eyes read; the diffuse overcast light gives the polished ornate steel a soft realistic sheen.
library_recipe.composition_side: Tall full-length SIDE/PROFILE: figure turned ~90 degrees to camera (true profile, NOT three-quarter), head-to-sabatons in frame with headroom above and floor below. Plain mid-grey backdrop, no scenery. Candid settled profile stance, longsword at rest; deep-blue cloak down the back. The shield rides on the NEAR arm with its face angled ~30 degrees toward the viewer so the gold-lion blazon stays legible, and the gold breastplate cross stays visible at the chest's front edge. Same man/armor/kit as the front, just turned to profile.
library_recipe.turnaround_do_not_include: Both views: do not crop or cut off the head, feet or sabatons (full body in frame); plain studio backdrop only (no scenery, props or furniture); no horse; no text, labels, watermark or borders. Side adds: must be a true side profile, never front-facing or three-quarter.

appearance.face: a man in his late twenties to early thirties, FRESHLY CLEAN-SHAVEN with completely smooth, bare, hairless skin on the jaw, chin, cheeks and upper lip — absolutely no beard, no moustache and not even faint stubble; a smooth-shaven young knight's face; fair-skinned and handsome, the weariness carried in the eyes and expression rather than in skin scruff; strong square jaw, straight nose, faint old scar; clear pale blue eyes, wide open and well-lit; rounded human ears; a candid, weary, un-posed expression
appearance.hair: wavy, tousled blond hair, medium-short, swept back off the brow and slightly matted from the road; dirty-gold, not bright
appearance.build: tall and athletic, broad-shouldered, the solid frame of a frontline fighter; an unhurried, settled soldier's bearing
appearance.armor: a PRISTINE, immaculately-maintained FULL PLATE harness worn over the whole body with NO cloth garment over it — no tabard, no surcoat, no fabric draped across the chest, and absolutely NO cloth arming-skirt or surcoat-skirt hanging between the legs; ORNATE knightly plate — silver-white steel DENSELY and richly decorated with bold, elaborate gold filigree, deep etched scrollwork and engraved inlay covering the breastplate, pauldrons, vambraces, gauntlets, faulds, tassets, cuisses, greaves and sabatons (filigree as dense and prominent as a parade harness, not sparse accents); cleanly polished with a soft REALISTIC satin/brushed-steel sheen catching the diffuse overcast light (NOT artificial chrome or CGI mirror-gloss); well-fitted and free of dents, rust or battle damage; the lower body is full ornate steel — faulds, tassets, cuisses, articulated greaves fully enclosing the shins, and ARTICULATED STEEL SABATONS on the feet (armored steel feet built from overlapping segmented lame plates across the top of the foot down to a defined pointed steel toe-cap — clearly metal, never smooth leather boots, never bulbous boot-toes) — with bare ornate metal between the legs
appearance.emblem: a gold cross of the Light worked into the center of the steel breastplate, framed by the surrounding gold filigree; small gold Light-cross motifs repeat as engraving on a pauldron and on the belt
appearance.cloak: a rich deep-blue wool cloak hanging from the shoulders behind the plate, clean and well-kept with only light travel-wear
appearance.heraldry: a kite/heater shield carried on the left arm bearing his arms — a single rampant GOLD lion on a DEEP-BLUE field; the shield is well-kept and clean, matching the polished ornate harness (not battered or scratched)
appearance.held_item: an ornate longsword with a gold-accented crossguard and pommel and a leather-wrapped grip, held loosely point-down or sheathed at the hip, candid and never raised or brandished

critical_clauses.clean_shaven_belt_and_suspenders: The model defaults to bearding/stubbling this knight. Push clean-shaven BOTH positively in `face` ('freshly clean-shaven, smooth bare hairless skin, weariness in the eyes not skin scruff') AND negatively in do_not_include ('no beard, moustache, goatee, sideburns, stubble or five-o'clock shadow'). One alone leaks stubble (spike R3); both together cleared it (R4).
critical_clauses.eye_lighting: Same as Garland — deep-set eyes drop into brow shadow. Soft warm even frontal fill on the face (head level-to-slightly-raised) so the pale-blue irises read clearly. Side effect: a slight upward/noble gaze; acceptable, watch it in composites.
critical_clauses.no_cloth_skirt_reroll: The stubborn defect (from the player ref's surcoat skirt): a cloth arming-skirt/fabric drape recurs between the legs below the steel faulds (~3/4 seeds in M3, again in M5 R1). Escalating prompt clauses REDUCE but do not eliminate it — it is generation variance defeated by RE-ROLLING, not more words. Budget a re-roll or two for Roderic's lower body, or accept bare ornate steel faulds as close-enough.
critical_clauses.sabaton_not_boots_reroll: Related lower-body variance from the refinement session: the feet tend to render as smooth bulbous boots rather than articulated steel sabatons (e.g. front r1/r2). Explicit 'overlapping segmented lames + steel toe-cap' language plus a RE-ROLL lands true sabatons (front r3/r4). Budget a re-roll for the feet, and verify them at zoom.

do_not_drift: no beard, moustache, goatee, sideburns, stubble or five-o'clock shadow of any kind — clean-shaven (override #1)
no tabard, surcoat or cloth garment over the breastplate, and no cloth arming-skirt/surcoat-skirt/fabric drape between the legs — bare ornate steel only (override #2)
pristine, well-kept, realistically-polished ornate gold-inlaid plate — NOT dull/matte/dented/rusted, and NOT artificial chrome/CGI mirror-gloss
full plate down to articulated greaves and STEEL SABATONS (armored feet) — never leather or cloth boots, never bulbous boot-toes
ears rounded and human — never pointed
keep the player refs' ornate gold and gold lion, but NOT their white cloth surcoat-skirt or artificial CGI/chrome sheen — those remain the drift to avoid
eyes lit and pale-blue readable, not in brow shadow
candid/un-posed — no heroic stance, no raised or brandished weapon
multi_subject_notes: Place via a `subjects` array entry with explicit placement and 'rounded human ears, clean-shaven, young, in plate' qualifiers, plus a do_not_include line forbidding the elf's beard/pointed ears/age. Zero bleed in M3/M5.
style_notes: Rendering handled globally by house-style.json EXCEPT for the documented house_style_exception (pristine/ornate/realistically-polished metal). Roderic was the de-gloss hard case; the de-gloss was then partially reversed (user 2026-05-31). Source his identity + armor from the validated front library image (config/image/library/sir-roderic-lightbearer-front.jpg), and the ornate-gold DENSITY + lion heraldry from the player refs — but render a realistic satin polish, never their artificial CGI sheen.
